Our Story

A Petti Full of Home

In Malayalam, petti means a box — the kind grandmothers packed before a long journey, layered with banana chips, crunchy murukku and jaggery-glazed sharkkara varatti wrapped in banana leaf.

Znacky Petti brings that same box to your doorstep. We work with small family kitchens across Kerala who still roast in traditional coconut oil, slice banana by hand, and season the old way — no shortcuts, no palm oil, no maida fillers.

Every batch is made fresh to order, sealed while it's still warm, and shipped within days — so what reaches you tastes like it just came off the stove in a Kerala tharavadu.

— Handcrafted by home cooks across Kerala

Our Process

From Kerala Farms to Your Petti

The same five steps our partner kitchens have followed for generations.

01

Sourced

Nendran bananas, farm tapioca, jaggery and coconuts, sourced fresh from Kerala growers.

02

Cleaned & Cut

Washed, peeled and hand-sliced the traditional way — no machines rushing the cut.

03

Roasted

Slow-fried in small batches of pure coconut oil for that unmistakable flavour.

04

Seasoned

Finished with authentic spice blends or jaggery glaze, the way home kitchens do it.

05

Packed Fresh

Cooled, weighed and sealed the same day, then shipped within 24–48 hours.
